label: Steamfrond
description: A rosette of mineral-pale fronds spiralled around a breathing vent, rims crusted with white salt bloom. Grows only at the seep oases -- the green eye in open nothing is a steamfrond ring before it is anything else. Its harvest scrapes seep-salt, a preservative and spice with the underworld's taste, and the only source of it.
